label: [Long-COVID syndrome and lung-specific abnormalities following COVID-19].
summary: Following the acute phase of a SARS-CoV-2 infection, post-COVID - or long-COVID - syndrome may develop. This condition is characterized by unpleasant, persistent or new-onset symptoms following the acute phase of the infection. It might lead to an impaired health-related quality of life of affected patients and may involve multiple organ systems.
